future_scopes.reason: No detailed tunnel product catalogue in this inventory; fire/smoke control, lining, ventilation, waterproofing and evacuation require separate expansion.
The current charging architecture does not define a complete overhead/third-rail collection system; add power collection, return current and stray-current assurance if adopted.
Every catalogued kit is mapped, but its fasteners, crimps, seals and fluids need a released piece-level BOM and scoped verification.
LM3 catalogue practices are candidates for other consist families; lengths, loads, interfaces and evidence require configuration-specific transfer review.
Public scopes support discovery only; adopt controlled complete ISO/IEC/EN and local requirements with clause-level traceability before acceptance.
